_source: Golden conversation (docs/plans/text-advisor/11-testing-rollout.md § Engine golden conversations). Model responses are hand-written to the Messages API shape; numbers are fictional (555 series).
description: Golden 2 (TA-I1 part): a new skipper says they run a boat; the model calls register_boat with the name and port it heard; the flow asks landing, Instagram and booking one text at a time (booking skipped), creates the pending boat with the new_skipper review, sends the completion text and the consent question; YES records consent with the message id; the next model turn's brief shows the boat, its status and consent. TA-I2: a media-only count-board photo is classified and read (vision fixtures), drafted and confirmed in the 05 shape, the board photo queued (consent given); Y publishes (verified frozen at 0 for the pending boat, clean_reports 1, pages version); 'lings were 14' corrects the published report; a catch photo with a person in it is queued, tagged and held for a has_person review.

turns.in: Hi, I run the Sea Example out of Morro Bay. Can I send you my reports?

content.text: Glad to have the Sea Example. A couple of quick questions for your boat page.

reply_contains: Glad to have the Sea Example

rows.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM advisor_boats
SELECT json_extract(value,'$.step') AS step FROM job_state WHERE key='advisor.flow.c1'

reply_contains: Your boat's Instagram handle, so we can tag you? (skip if none)
A booking link or phone for the boat page? (skip)

Got it. Sea Example is set up. Your reports will show on skippercast.com/boats/sea-example once the team confirms the boat, usually same day. Text me a photo of today's count board whenever you're in.
One more thing: OK for SkipperCast to post your photos and videos on our Instagram and Facebook, always credited and tagged to Sea Example? Reply YES.

rows.sql: SELECT slug,name,landing,port,region,instagram,booking_url,phone_public,status,owner_contact_id,consent_photos_at FROM advisor_boats

SELECT kind,reason,status FROM advisor_reviews
SELECT json_extract(value,'$.flow') AS flow, json_extract(value,'$.step') AS step FROM job_state WHERE key='advisor.flow.c1'

reply_contains: Thanks. Your photos can go on the SkipperCast feed, tagged to Sea Example.

turns.in: thanks, see you after the trip
